name: Zenith Sensual Dance
name_jp: 究極センシュアルダンス
effects: Causes [ATK, DEF, MAG, RES and MND -50% (25s)], grants [Pentabreak Damage Boost (15s)] and [Quick Cast] to all allies, grants [Zenith Mode] and [Zenith Mode: Lilisette] to the user

description.name: Entry
description.text: Causes [ATK, DEF, MAG, RES and MND -50% (25s)], grants [Pentabreak Damage Boost (15s)] and [Quick Cast] to all allies, grants [Zenith Mode] and [Zenith Mode: Lilisette] to the user

description.name: Zenith Mode: Lilisette
description.text: Cast speed x1.10 for Support, Celerity or Dancer abilities, casts Spirit Attack: Lilisette after using a Support, Celerity or Dancer ability (max 3), maximum HP +1500, grants [Astra] after taking the next action, removed if the character hasn't [Zenith Mode]

description.name: Sensual Dance+
description.text: Restores 2500 HP, causes [ATK, DEF and MAG -50% (8s)] to all enemies

description.name: Dancer's Cheer+
description.text: Transfers the user's Soul Break points to the target (maximum of 500 Soul Break points), grants [Instant Cast 1]

description.name: Spirit Attack: Lilisette
description.text: Causes [Imperil Prismatic 10% (5s)] and grants [Buff Prismatic 10% (5s)] to all allies

description.name: ATK, DEF, MAG, RES and MND -50% (25s)

description.name: Pentabreak Damage Boost (15s)
description.text: Increases damage dealt by 5/10/15/20/30% if target has 1/2/3/4/5 of ATK, DEF, MAG, RES or MND reduced

description.name: Zenith Mode
description.text: Replaces certain Hero Abilities, certain Hero Abilities don't consume uses, after the duration the status only expires after the character takes an action
